integrity: The analytical theorem concerns global identifiability and the exact lower-order ambiguity; previously published full forward transforms and finite-time moments are explicitly acknowledged. An independent audit and definitive publication-priority assessment have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes a stationary two-state continuous-time Markov diffusivity, two distinct strictly positive diffusivities and positive transition rates, independent Brownian forcing and ideal population cumulants at two fixed positive durations. It neither proves finite-sample stability nor covers nonstationary, continuously varying or multistate diffusivity.
title: Four cumulant observations identify a two-state fluctuating diffusivity
